remarks: HEAT, HOT WATER & COOKING GAS INCLUDED - Experience elevated living in the highly desirable Springdale section of Stamford!  Welcome to 27 Northill, a well-maintained and amenity-rich community designed for both comfort and convenience. Residents enjoy access to on-site laundry facilities, a fully equipped fitness center, secured entry for peace of mind, and reserved parking-making everyday living effortless.  Perfectly positioned in a commuter-friendly location, you'll love being just a short walk to the Springdale train station, as well as a variety of local restaurants, shops, and athletic facilities. Whether you're heading into the city or enjoying everything Stamford has to offer, this location truly delivers.  This stunning top-floor unit offers a bright and airy living space with a thoughtfully designed layout. The oversized bedroom provides a relaxing retreat, while the expansive living area is perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. Abundant closet space throughout ensures you'll have room for everything, and the unit's clean, well-maintained condition makes it completely move-in ready.  From the included utilities to the unbeatable location and comfortable living space, this is an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of Stamford's most sought-after communities.  Come see for yourself why everyone loves calling 27 Northill home!
